parameters.query: SELECT face_id, person_id, person_name, distance, metadata FROM find_closest_face('{{ $json.embedding_str }}'::vector, 0.4);

WITH new_person AS (
  INSERT INTO persons (name, metadata)
  VALUES ('Desconocido_{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.timestamp }}', '{"auto_registered": true}')
  RETURNING id
),
new_face AS (
  INSERT INTO face_embeddings (person_id, embedding, image_base64, confidence)
  SELECT id, '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.embedding_str }}'::vector, '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.image_base64 }}', 1.0
  FROM new_person
  RETURNING id, person_id
),
log_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO detection_logs (person_id, is_known, similarity, mqtt_topic, device_id, image_base64, matched_face_id)
  SELECT nf.person_id, false, null, '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.mqtt_topic }}', '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.device_id }}', '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.image_base64 }}', nf.id
  FROM new_face nf
)
SELECT nf.person_id, nf.id AS face_id FROM new_face nf;

INSERT INTO detection_logs (person_id, is_known, similarity, mqtt_topic, device_id, image_base64, matched_face_id)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Buscar en Supabase').item.json.person_id }}'::uuid,
  true,
  {{ $('Buscar en Supabase').item.json.distance }},
  '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.mqtt_topic }}',
  '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.device_id }}',
  '{{ $('Procesar Embedding').item.json.image_base64 }}',
  '{{ $('Buscar en Supabase').item.json.face_id }}'::uuid
)
RETURNING id;
